minutes.headline: Board imposed a two-week liquor license suspension on JNM Sports Bar after finding four violations
minutes.summary: The Select Board held a violation hearing for JNM Sports Bar, found violations of the license regulations and imposed a two-week suspension. It approved a manager and beneficial-interest change for Mickey Shay's, an auto show, an arts festival entertainment license and beach appointments. It then reviewed progress on board and town manager goals and entered executive session on the town manager's contract.

public_comment.topic: Objected to being cut off at last week's public comment; raised student and staff safety concerns about more traffic on the school campus if the Passios building becomes a town hall.
The police chief announced a charity basketball game on June 14 to raise funds for AEDs for the police department.
Thanked the town manager and a departing board member; suggested big signs announcing elections and events.
Urged economic development to prioritize helping existing small businesses grow.

what_happened.line: The Select Board found JNM Sports Bar in violation of four license regulations after a hearing.
The Board imposed a suspension, first moved at three weeks and amended to two weeks starting June 10.
The Board approved a manager and beneficial-interest change for Mickey Shay's.
The Board approved the Auto Show request for Memorial Drive and the Arts Festival entertainment license with a rain date.
The Board ratified the town manager's beach coordinator and lifeguard appointments; the quarterly financial report was held to the next meeting.

why_it_matters: The suspension means JNM Sports Bar cannot operate under its liquor license for two weeks, and the finding of violations goes on its licensing record with the town.
The goals review and the FY19 facilities and capital items show where town budget money, mostly taxes, is going for building upkeep such as the DPW roof and Turkey Hill asbestos work.

Board goal-setting workshop for next year's goals, planned by July (t=5657).
